title: Virtual Machine Consolidation in Cloud Computing Using Prophet's Forecasting Tool (reproduction package)
description:
Self-contained Docker reproduction package for WBP (WPSP + Bollinger Bands + Prophet), a network-aware proactive virtual-machine consolidation method for cloud data centers, built on CloudSim/MetaCloudSim. It includes the simulator, the experiment configurations, 100-VM workload subsets (PlanetLab, Alibaba 2018, Materna, Microsoft Azure 2019), the forecasting code and the analysis scripts, plus partial re-implementations of the AMOVMC and EUQ-VMC (2025) baselines in the same simulator.

Version 0.3.0 accompanies the first revision of the manuscript: corrected result tables; the configurations, scripts and tables of the revision experiments (closed-loop replacement of the forecaster, sensitivity to the Bollinger parameters, forecast accuracy, and two further traces of Alibaba and two of Materna); and the per-run caches from which every table is computed. See CHANGELOG.md and REPRODUCE.md.
